attrs.quote: If any difficulty arises in giving effect to the provisions of this Act, the Central Government may, by order published in the Official Gazette
attrs.note: Absent: S.O. 5458(E) of 5 October 2026, reported to correct wording in sections 9(1) and 10(2)(c)(ii), was not located on egazette.gov.in; quote is section 43(1) of the Act, under which it is made. Answers here use Rules 10 and 13.
